review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: A rigorous category-theoretic framework connecting symmetry breaking functors to spectral properties of induced operators on quotient spaces. Specifically, we need: (1) A functor from the category of G-spaces with broken symmetry to the category of Hilbert spaces with anomalous spectral properties, (2) Rigorous characterization of 'fundamental difference' in spectral properties as a categorical invariant, (3) Extension of Goldstone theorem to general topological groups beyond Lie groups
